name: La Tâche
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for La Tâche (#461). None establishes current farming.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list names La Tâche and Les Gaudichots; the pinned cadastre divides the cru between LA TACHE and LES GAUDICHOTS OU LA TACHE. Both are audited, but the whole-cru outline is retained: the cru's own name is also one named area's name, so a La Tâche label cannot select either area without ambiguity. Producer holdings are not shown.
